question.value: What are the host galaxy properties (dust, dynamical and gas masses, SFR, companions, [C II]-Mg II offsets) of luminous z~4.8 quasars, split into Herschel-detected (FIR-bright) and undetected (FIR-faint)?

evidence.quote:
we continue to probe the connection between SMBHs and their host galaxies using an optically selected, flux-limited sample of the most luminous quasars at $z \sim
4.8$.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2016.1.01515.S.
The twelve new targets were observed using ALMA band-7 during the Cycle-4 period of 2016 November 9 to 2017 May 6.

findings_qualitative.value: Companions are found preferentially around FIR-faint quasars; FIR-bright all lie >=1 dex above the main sequence

evidence.quote: Clearly, all of our FIR-bright quasars are found in the starbursting domain and at least 1 dex from the MS.

claims.hypothesis: Is the Mg II BLR line offset from the host systemic redshift traced by [CII]?
claims.experiment: Compare [CII] and Mg II redshifts for 17 hosts plus literature compilation
claims.result: Mean offset 464 km/s (median 379); compilation mean 372 km/s
claims.finding: Mg II is blueshifted by several hundred km/s relative to host

evidence.quote: This result strongly suggests a velocity difference between the BLR and quasar host galaxies of several hundred km s$^{-1}$.

claims.hypothesis: Do FIR-bright quasars show more companions (mergers) than FIR-faint ones?
claims.experiment: Search for [CII]/continuum companions in ALMA maps
claims.finding: Companions preferentially around FIR-faint; possibly earlier merger stage

evidence.quote: 1 FIR-bright (J1511) and 4 FIR-faint (J0923, J1328, J2057, and J1447), i.e., 28 percent.

claims.hypothesis: Do the hosts lie on the z~5 main sequence?
claims.experiment: Compare SFR vs Mstar (0.4 Mdyn) with MS curves
claims.finding: Hosts are starbursting relative to main sequence

evidence.quote: We find that the majority of our sources lie above the MS curves.

why_this_method.value: [CII] and FIR continuum chosen because AGN dominates optical-NIR

evidence.quote: The best strategy is to observe these systems in the far-IR (FIR), where dust heated by the starformation dominates the continuum emission
